GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 560 (15 Sep 45) ESS
(SCAPIN - 30)
APO 500
15 September 1945
MEMO FOR : Mr. Suzuki, Central Liaison Committee, Japanese Government
SUBJECT : Repair of Inoperative Ships
1. It is urged that every effort be made to expedite the repair of ships that are at present inoperative. It is further urged that every effort be made to expedite the completion of non-combat merchant vessels that were under construction at the time of the surrender.
2. It is requested that this office be advised at the earliest practicable time of the plans for increasing the available shipping by the repair and completion of such ships. If any authorizations are required from this Headquarters to expedite this work, it is requested that they be brought to the attention of this office at once.
/s/ R. C. Kramer
/t/ R. C. KRAMER
Colonel, G.S.C.,
Chief, Economic and Scientific Section
